# T-4: Report task results

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Show task completion and verification results in task completion output and the final report.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Task gate PASS output includes completed task id and next task id or no-pending-task state.
- Final report includes task id, task status, implementation summary availability, test-execute result, review result, and gate-impl result when present.
- Explicit broad mode records appear in status or final report output.

## Implementation Notes
Use existing task state, metrics, notes, issue-log, and finalize report assembly. Do not invent report data when artifacts are missing; display missing values explicitly.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for report rendering with multiple tasks, missing artifacts, and broad mode audit entries.
